title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. translated_title: AmbiSteer：在视觉语言模型中选择性引出歧义感知响应
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）常常表现出过度自信，即使视觉证据不足时也会给出确定的答案。一个突出的例子是视觉问答（VQA）中的指代歧义问题，即图像中的多个实体都可能是问题的合理指代对象。处理这类情况需要识别歧义何时存在：对于有歧义的问题，可以通过请求澄清或列举可能的指代对象来处理，而对于无歧义的问题则应给出直接回答。当前的视觉语言模型难以做出这种区分，常常默认采用单一解释。为了研究激活引导是否可以作为一种推理时机制来引出此类行为，我们提出了 AmbiSteer，一个用于选择性引出歧义感知行为的轻量级框架。在三个视觉语言模型上的实验表明，仅使用激活引导的效果有限且依赖于具体模型，而提示方法通常更为有效。通过结合……
tldr: 提出 AmbiSteer 轻量级框架，通过结合激活引导与提示方法，在推理时选择性地引出视觉语言模型的歧义感知行为，使其能够正确处理视觉问答中的指代歧义问题。
en_tdlr: AmbiSteer is a lightweight framework that combines activation steering with prompting to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior in vision-language models at inference time, enabling them to properly handle referential ambiguity in VQA.
